title: Milestones idempotent across reruns
input_events: Decide re-runs on identical state (no new episodes).
expected: zero milestone mutations: the "milestones" array comes back with the same labels, the same states and the same "episodes" as the run before — byte-identical structure. Nothing new is created because nothing new arrived.

source.section: GoldenEvals V6P1 §1.1 (carried) CHP-06 · Chapters idempotent across reruns — re-authored at the S6 gate onto the V6 vocabulary (decide.v9 emits "milestones", never "chapters"). The assertion is unchanged: an identical input produces an identical structure.
